lines.text: Decades of nightmares developing software by hand (and not AI) has taught software engineers this incredibly easy but hard lesson: Backup, version, backup, version, backup, version.
lines.reason: Introduces the first key technique: versioning everything.

lines.text: And we know your prompts are cool and all, but really context is everything.
lines.reason: Introduces the second key technique: context as everything.

lines.text: I can shift from GPT to Claude in seconds because my context and artefacts are all transferrable.
lines.reason: Illustrates the benefit of transferable context and artefacts.

lines.text: And Context, well it’s nothing but a collection of Artefacts.
lines.reason: Defines context as a collection of artefacts.
